name: anim_hira_idle
subject: a very tall, extremely muscular horse man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream swirls, a spiky dripping brown and cream mane, wide-open eyes and a toothy grin, straight human legs with bare human feet
desc: Idle loop: slow calm breathing, the huge chest rises only slightly (subtle, not inflating), the shoulders roll a little, thick brown paint keeps dripping and sagging from the chin, the mane strands and the hands, sticky drips stretch and fall, the body sways a little. Stays in place with both feet planted. The face keeps the same wide-eyed toothy grin. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
